name: Time Scarab
descriptionTemplate: {Annihilation} grants the Awakener with the lowest Aliemus gains [Arg1] Aliemus, with a cooldown of 3 turns.
lore:
A pocket watch found both in a clock shop and an insect museum.
It has been incorporated into the university's collection since the Flood.
